MEAT the Founder

A letter from Sabri Ally

Growing up in Barking, East London, I was always in the gym before I was anywhere else. Training was more than a hobby to me — it was a lifestyle, a discipline, a way of building myself up from the ground floor. But there was one problem that followed me from my teenage years right through to adulthood: finding halal, high-protein food that actually fit that lifestyle was a mission in itself.

While my training partners could walk into any shop and grab a protein-packed ready meal or a quick frozen bite between sessions, I'd be lucky to find anything that ticked the halal box, let alone something that tasted good or supported my goals. It wasn't just an inconvenience — it was a gap. A gap that told an entire community, my community, that we weren't really being catered for.

That gap is where FormAflame was born.

I didn't want the next generation of gym-goers, busy professionals, and families in areas like mine to keep making do with the scraps of what was available. I wanted us to have real options — halal meat done properly, frozen pizzas that don't compromise on taste or quality, and everyday essentials that respect both our faith and our fitness. Food that fuels ambition without forcing anyone to choose between convenience and conviction.

FormAflame isn't just a frozen food company to me. It's a statement — that halal doesn't mean limited, and convenience doesn't mean compromise. It's for every kid growing up in a Barking, London, or anywhere else in the world, who deserves to open a freezer and see themselves represented in what's inside.

This is just the beginning.

Sabri Ally
Founder, FormAflame
